'''Shemaen''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of unknown [[Ajah]].

==History==
During the [[Aiel War]], Shemaen is told by [[Adelorna Bastine]] about [[Gitara Moroso]]'s [[Foretelling]] that the [[Last Battle]] will come during the lifetime of sisters now breathing. [[Ellid Abareim]] overhears this conversation and repeats it to her fellow [[Accepted]], [[Moiraine Damodred]] and [[Siuan Sanche]].{{ref/book|0|8}}
